## Motivation

The MI355X Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 AgentX run in InferenceX was updated in [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4374](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4374): HiCache write policy `write_through_selective` -> `write_through`, on a newer image. At concurrency 80 the AgentX cache hit rate moves from 51% to about 95%. This follows up on #41849 so the cookbook matches the official run.

## Modifications

`docs/src/snippets/autoregressive/qwen35-deployment.jsx`

- 397B + MI355X + FP8 + HiCache now emits `--hicache-write-policy write_through` instead of `write_through_selective`. All other flags are unchanged.

`docs/cookbook/autoregressive/Qwen/Qwen3.5.mdx`

- MI355X `docker pull`: `v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260927` -> `v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261020` (the tag used in #4374).
- MI300X / MI325X `docker pull`: `v0.5.15.post1-rocm720-mi30x-20260715` -> `v0.5.22-rocm720-mi30x-20261020` (same date as MI355X).
- Update the "KV cache offloading (397B FP8 on MI355X)" bullet to the new write policy.

The generated command for every other hardware, precision and toggle combination is unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Documentation-only; no runtime code path is touched.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

No change in this PR. Numbers come from the InferenceX run in #4374 (TP4 HiCache, concurrency 80):

| Image | hicache-write-policy | Cache hit rate |
|---|---|---|
| `v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260929` | `write_through_selective` | 51% |
| `v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261020` | `write_through` | ~95% |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Contributor Guide](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

files.patch:
@@ -103,10 +103,10 @@ uv pip install --prerelease=allow 'git+https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git
 docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:latest
 
 # Or use Docker (AMD MI300X/MI325X)
-docker pull lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.15.post1-rocm720-mi30x-20260715
+docker pull lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi30x-20261020
 
 # Or use Docker (AMD MI355X)
-docker pull lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.20-rocm720-mi35x-20260927
+docker pull lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm720-mi35x-20261020
 ```
 
 For the full Docker setup and other installation methods, please refer to the [official SGLang installation guide](../../../docs/get-started/install).
@@ -127,7 +127,7 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware
 - **H100 / B200 / B300 FP8:** Add `--enable-symm-mem` to enable NCCL symmetric memory for faster collectives and better performance under multi-GPU settings. It only helps when tp > 1, so on B200/B300 it applies to the 397B-A17B FP8 recipe (tp=4); the 122B-A10B and 35B-A3B FP8 recipes are single-GPU there.
 - **AMD GPUs (MI300X / MI325X / MI355X):** Use `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1` and `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1` with `--attention-backend aiter`, which requires `--page-size 16` and can also enable `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion`. Additionally set `AITER_FLYDSL_FORCE=1` to force the AITER FlyDSL MoE kernels and `SGLANG_MAMBA_SSM_DTYPE=bfloat16` to store the Mamba SSM state in bfloat16 (instead of the default float32). For the **MXFP4 checkpoint on MI355X**, set `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION=INT4` to route multi-GPU collectives through INT4-quantized ROCm quick all-reduce, and drop `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion` (the two are mutually exclusive; quick all-reduce is preferred for this recipe).
 - **KV cache offloading (MXFP4 on MI355X):** Selecting **Host DRAM (HiCache)** adds a host-memory tier below the device KV cache, which lets long-context agentic workloads keep more prefix cached and reach higher concurrency than the device KV pool alone allows. It emits `--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 1.5 --hicache-write-policy write_through --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-mem-layout page_first`. HiCache extends the radix cache, so the generated command drops `--disable-radix-cache` — the two options are mutually exclusive and SGLang rejects them together at startup. `--hicache-ratio 1.5` sizes the host tier at 1.5x the device KV cache, so make sure the node has that much free CPU DRAM per server on top of the model weights. Leave this **Disabled** for fixed-length throughput serving, where the extra host traffic buys nothing.
-- **KV cache offloading (397B FP8 on MI355X):** A separate recipe from the MXFP4 one above, for long-context agentic serving of the FP8 checkpoint. Selecting **Host DRAM (HiCache)** emits `--tp 4` instead of the tp=2 that merely fits the weights, `--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 1.5 --hicache-write-policy write_through_selective --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-mem-layout page_first`, and `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3` to halve device KV bytes. `write_through_selective` keeps non-reusable blocks out of the host tier. This arm keeps `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion` and does not set `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION`; the MXFP4 recipe does the opposite. Read the FP8 KV cache warning below before using it for reasoning-heavy work.
+- **KV cache offloading (397B FP8 on MI355X):** A separate recipe from the MXFP4 one above, for long-context agentic serving of the FP8 checkpoint. Selecting **Host DRAM (HiCache)** emits `--tp 4` instead of the tp=2 that merely fits the weights, `--enable-hierarchical-cache --hicache-ratio 1.5 --hicache-write-policy write_through --hicache-io-backend kernel --hicache-mem-layout page_first`, and `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3` to halve device KV bytes. `write_through` mirrors every page to the host tier as it is written. This arm keeps `--enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion` and does not set `ROCM_QUICK_REDUCE_QUANTIZATION`; the MXFP4 recipe does the opposite. Read the FP8 KV cache warning below before using it for reasoning-heavy work.
 - **Watchdog timeout:** Increase `--watchdog-timeout` to `1200` or higher for this large model, as weight loading can take significant time.
 - **Mamba Radix Cache**: Qwen3.5's hybrid Gated Delta Networks architecture supports two mamba scheduling strategies via `--mamba-radix-cache-strategy`:
   - **V1 (`no_buffer`)**: Default. No overlap scheduler, lower memory usage. Required for AMD MI GPUs.
